messages.subject: PP 펠릿 문헌/제품 조사 완료 — REPORT·sources·README
messages.body: I researched all 10 PP pellet property items across papers, datasheets and test standards, with 4 read-only helper agents, then re-checked key numbers against the original sources myself. Findings: solid density 0.898–0.91, friction PP-PP 0.43–0.8 and PP-steel 0.26–0.30, restitution 0.83–0.85 as a material value and 0.3–0.85 in DEM calibrations; no source anywhere gives PP-paper or PP-PLA friction, single-pellet mass, pellets per gram or short-axis size for our pellets, so those need measuring. The report lists 7 calibration papers and 5 Korean sale pages and compares 6 density methods (the reference video is an Archimedes-type electronic density meter; its model is not identified). Still open: several key papers such as Landgraeber 2025 and Yurata 2021 could not be opened, and choosing which values to adopt or measure is left to the coordinator. REPORT: /home/cgxr/orca/workspaces/RoArm_Project/w26-pellet-priors/claudedocs/research/w26_pellet_priors_20260930/REPORT.md | 10/10 items filled (none empty), 7 calibration papers + 11 measurement/method papers, 5 Korean sale pages, 6 density methods, 97 sources.
